description: The image presents two pie charts intended to show the distribution of co-occurring tokens with the word “reaction” in two different domains: chemistry and mathematics. Chart (a) contains six slices representing the tokens “the” (9%), “this” (7%), “for” (31%), “chemical” (21%), “to” (17%), and “in” (15%). Chart (b) consists of four slices representing the tokens “the” (15%), “$” (19%), “equilibrium” (27%), and “consatant” (38%). Both charts include a legend identifying the tokens and corresponding colors. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. In both charts, the slices appear to be arranged in descending order of their proportional representation, starting with the largest slice at the top and proceeding clockwise. No slices are visually emphasized through features like exploding or bolding.
